description: Power BI reports are often built around static charts, even when the story is really about how values, rankings, targets, and market positions change over time. Ataytis Motion adds time-based playback and enhanced business-chart capabilities to Power BI, helping report creators show movement, progression, comparison, and change in a more intuitive way. It combines multiple animated and enhanced chart types in one visual, with a consistent editor, flexible playback controls, image support, ranking options, targets, comparisons, and advanced formatting. Reports remain useful as normal business visuals when playback is stopped, while animation adds an additional way to explore how the data developed. Why Ataytis Motion? Key features: Multiple chart types in one visual, including Bar Race, Lollipop Race, Leaderboard, Bump Race, Line and Area, Line and Column, Donut and Pie, Funnel, Treemap, Waterfall, and Gauge. Time-based playback with play, pause, replay, previous and next controls, timeline scrubbing, configurable playback speed, and support for different time periods and ordered axis values. Animated ranking and movement views that make it easier to see categories rise, fall, overtake one another, enter the leading group, or move through the ranking over time.
